preconditions.description: Both inputs a and b must be strings.

postconditions.description: The result is the concatenation of the modified version of a and the modified version of b.

postconditions.expression: modified_b == ''.join(b[i].swapcase() if (a.count(b[i].lower()) % 2 == 1) else b[i] for i in range(len(b)))
postconditions.description: For each character in b, if the count of its case-insensitive occurrences in a is odd, swap its case; otherwise keep it unchanged.

postconditions.expression: modified_a == ''.join(a[i].swapcase() if (b.count(a[i].lower()) % 2 == 1) else a[i] for i in range(len(a)))
postconditions.description: For each character in a, if the count of its case-insensitive occurrences in b is odd, swap its case; otherwise keep it unchanged.
